set.body:
Outcome: ListView and TreeView share TableView keyboard-visible border; ordinary focus keeps the decorative border. Report https://github.com/canardlapin/meridianfx/issues/5 at cf5bbff69203556ee8b31ea566502d502e766386. Scope: one generic focus recipe, four generated themes/manifests, native DataFocusProbe and bounded evidence; no selection palette change (#4), docking/provider/pin change or broad accessibility qualification.
Acceptance:
- [x] Reproduce missing list/tree ring and existing table ring on native JavaFX before editing.
- [x] All four compiled themes give list/tree/table the 2px semantic focus-ring border only in focus-visible state; ordinary focus and clearing focus-visible restore decorative1px border.
- [x] Native regression checks computed border colors/widths and actual Scene focus ownership (CSS focus states explicitly controlled) for all three controls in both densities/schemes; captures and commands/exits retained.
- [x] Theme regeneration is byte-verified; relevant Python/native smoke checks pass; scope and limitations documented.
Checks: baseline/corrected native probe, independent theme compilation/byte check, Python theme/token suite and ThemeSmoke. Pseudo-class render evidence does not establish OS input/screen-reader qualification.

Local acceptance: docs/evidence/data-focus/README.md. Source digest 7dadefce0ae0b9d4b4fc6510a1486ad5101429e03597257c243dff718d71dd30. Native48states/12captures, Python30tests, existing ThemeSmoke249assertions pass. No upstream issue closure, commit or push. OS input/screen-reader qualification and issue4 remain separate.
